game.title: Far Cry New Dawn
game.blurb: Open-world first-person shooter set in a post-apocalyptic Hope County, Montana, from Ubisoft Montreal, released 2019-02-15. RAWG average playtime: 12 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter, Adventure, Arcade. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Helping the people of Prosperity, facing the Twins and the return to New Eden. Some steps are host only in co-op.

chapters.title: Prosperity and Guns for Hire
chapters.summary: Upgrading Prosperity's infrastructure, recruiting every Gun For Hire, and companions such as Horatio and Timber.

chapters.title: Outposts and the Highwaymen
chapters.summary: Scavenging and liberating Outposts, supply drops and ethanol tankers, up to Rank III.

chapters.title: Expeditions
chapters.summary: Expeditions away from Hope County, on Rank III and with a co-op partner.

chapters.title: Exploration and Collectibles
chapters.summary: Treasure Hunts, safes, plants, fishing, skins, Dear Photograph spots, MP3 players and scouts.

chapters.title: Crafting and Perks
chapters.summary: Crafting medkits, weapons and Legendary gear, and buying perks.

chapters.title: Combat Feats
chapters.summary: Takedowns, Enforcers, shields, saw launchers, Wrath, Leap of Faith and long-range arrows.

collectibles.name: The Meaning of Prosperity
collectibles.where: Help Carmina get back to her mother in Prosperity. Host only.

collectibles.name: Prospering
collectibles.where: Upgrade and secure Prosperity. Host only.

collectibles.name: Return to Eden
collectibles.where: Bring the Father back to New Eden. Host only.

collectibles.name: Problem Solver
collectibles.where: Solve the biggest problem in Hope County by defeating the Twins. Host only.

collectibles.name: The End of Eden
collectibles.where: Decide the fate of the Father. Host only.

collectibles.name: A Graceful Return
collectibles.where: Recover Grace's prototype gun and welcome her back to Prosperity for good. Host only.

collectibles.name: Coming Up With the Goods
collectibles.where: Return Selene's valuable stash. Host only.

collectibles.name: Wiki-Bean-ia in Business
collectibles.where: Help Bean get back his business plan so he can set up his intel network in Prosperity. Host only.

collectibles.name: The Ryeunion
collectibles.where: Reunite Nick Rye with Carmina and Kim. Host only.

collectibles.name: Expeditious Retreat
collectibles.where: Complete your first Expedition to force the Highwaymen out of a stronghold.

collectibles.name: Honorary Scout
collectibles.where: Gather intel 10 times by talking to Wiki-Bean-ia scouts. Host only.

collectibles.name: Yoink
collectibles.where: Loot a Highwaymen Supply Drop. Be careful, it won't be unguarded!

collectibles.name: Forager
collectibles.where: Gather 15 plants growing in Hope County. It's the closest thing to a pharmacy we have nowadays.

collectibles.name: Reduce, Reuse, Recycle
collectibles.where: Scavenge an Outpost. You can always reclaim it. Host only.

collectibles.name: Home is Where the Part Is
collectibles.where: Upgrade Prosperity's infrastructure for the first time by investing in the right parts. Host only.

collectibles.name: Sidecar Sidekick
collectibles.where: Drive with Timber for a total of 5 minutes. Just don't take him to the vet.

collectibles.name: White Gold
collectibles.where: Commandeer an Ethanol tanker and bring it back to one of your outposts.

collectibles.name: Finders Keepers
collectibles.where: Complete 3 Treasure Hunt missions. Host only.

collectibles.name: Safekeeping
collectibles.where: Picklock 5 safes. With no more banks, it's the closest thing you'll get to experiencing a heist.

collectibles.name: Closed for Applications
collectibles.where: Recruit all Guns For Hire. Host only.

collectibles.name: How's it Look, Doc?
collectibles.where: Craft 10 Medkits. They'll definitely come in handy.

collectibles.name: Kill or Be Killed
collectibles.where: Kill a Monstrous animal. It'd do the same to you given half the chance.

collectibles.name: Paladin’s Secret
collectibles.where: Find Sam Fisher’s outfit in the Government Plane Wreck expedition

collectibles.name: Before
collectibles.where: Find all the Dear Photograph locations and see Hope County as it used to be. Host only.

collectibles.name: Audiophile
collectibles.where: Rediscover some sweet tunes for the new world. Find all hidden MP3 players. Host only.

collectibles.name: My Little Fortress
collectibles.where: Make Prosperity better than ever! Build all Infrastructure upgrades available. Host only.

collectibles.name: Master Skinner
collectibles.where: Collect at least one skin from every type of animal in Hope County. Not creepy at all.

collectibles.name: Hit the Road
collectibles.where: Complete 7 unique Expeditions on the Rank III difficulty.

collectibles.name: Pure Ninja
collectibles.where: Liberate a Rank III Outpost while staying undetected.

collectibles.name: All Your Bases
collectibles.where: Liberate all Outposts at least once on Rank III.

collectibles.name: Weaponsmith
collectibles.where: Craft 3 weapons. They don't need to look good, they just need to get the job done!

collectibles.name: You're a Catch
collectibles.where: Successfully catch one of every type of fish in Hope County. Get those omega-3s.

collectibles.name: Save Your Bacon
collectibles.where: Recruit Horatio. Don't mind his temper, he can be pig-headed sometimes. Host only.

collectibles.name: Poof!
collectibles.where: Use 3 smoke grenades.

collectibles.name: It's Super Effective!
collectibles.where: Headshot an Enforcer with Piercing Ammo.

collectibles.name: Have Buddy, Will Travel
collectibles.where: Complete 3 Expeditions with a co-op partner.

collectibles.name: Bring a Knife to a Gun Fight
collectibles.where: Kill 25 enemies using any type of takedown. Put that railroad spike to good use!

collectibles.name: Captain's Courageous
collectibles.where: Kill your first Enforcer. I'm sure this will send the Highwaymen a good message.

collectibles.name: Good Job, Cap
collectibles.where: Kill 5 enemies by throwing a shield at them.

collectibles.name: Stack 'em Up
collectibles.where: Purchase the 5th tier of a stackable perk. You can never have enough.

collectibles.name: Fly, You Fools!
collectibles.where: No wings means less drag, right? Take a short flight in the wingless plane.

collectibles.name: Buzzkill
collectibles.where: Kill 10 brawlers with any saw launcher. They never saw it coming.

collectibles.name: Legend Has It
collectibles.where: Craft your first Legendary Weapon or Vehicle and start a legend of your own.

collectibles.name: Tip o' the Hat
collectibles.where: Knock an enemy's helmet off with a charged melee attack.

collectibles.name: Anger Management
collectibles.where: Eliminate 10 enemies within a single activation of Wrath.

collectibles.name: Hey Father, Watch This
collectibles.where: Perform an Aerial Takedown after using Leap of Faith.

collectibles.name: Perk-olate
collectibles.where: Unlock the first level for all Perks.

collectibles.name: Archery Expert
collectibles.where: Kill an enemy more than 100m away with a basic arrow.

collectibles.name: Get to the Point
collectibles.where: Finish off an Enforcer with a bayonet.

collectibles.name: Springboard
collectibles.where: Survive a 30m fall using only Leap of Faith to nullify the impact.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0); its Walkthrough, Gameplay and Table of Contents subpages are linked but none exists, so nothing was used. farcry.fandom.com answers the API, with about 233 linked pages, including "Prosperity (Far Cry New Dawn)", "Mickey", "Lou" and "Lost Expedition"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. None of the 50 Steam achievements is hidden, and many story ones say "Host only", meaning they unlock only for the host in co-op.
